id./param/scenario/cs/c_020_cs_140.pack|cs_: To think you'd come this far...

I am Calasmos,
one born from the abyss of darkness.

"S-so this is Calasmos...
  What dreadful malice...

The Tree's soul left by the Holy Dragon.
Snuff it out and all is darkness.
Darkness is my joy.

"Not a foe humans can handle...
  Worse than imagined, but
  we have no choice.

"Don't be afraid, everyone!
  If we don't defeat him,
  this world is finished!

"Ready, {var:1}!
  Now is the time to fulfill
  the Luminary's true mission!
"This is the final battle! Let's go!

Come, descendants of the light.
Time, memory, space... I will stain
everything that exists with darkness.
